# coldd Development

> coldd Development is a studio that builds and sells game-ready assets for
> Roblox: finished games, game templates, maps, scripts and UI systems,
> graphics, buildings, vehicles, weapons, uniforms, boats, and animations and
> VFX. Every purchase is an instant download after checkout. Resell licences
> are available on most products. Payments: card, PayPal, crypto, and Robux.

## Store

- [Shop - all products](https://coldd.dev/shop): the full Roblox catalogue, filterable by category, price and newest.
- [Finished Games & Templates](https://coldd.dev/shop?cat=game-templates): complete, launch-ready Roblox games and starter templates.
- [Maps](https://coldd.dev/shop?cat=maps): standalone Roblox map builds.
- [Scripts & UI](https://coldd.dev/shop?cat=scripts-ui): gameplay systems, HUDs, inventory and menu UI kits.
- [Graphics](https://coldd.dev/shop?cat=graphics): thumbnails, logos and icon kits.
- [Buildings](https://coldd.dev/shop?cat=buildings): individual structures and set pieces.
- [Vehicles](https://coldd.dev/shop?cat=vehicles), [Boats](https://coldd.dev/shop?cat=boats), [Weapons](https://coldd.dev/shop?cat=weapons): prop and mechanic packs.
- [Uniforms & Gear](https://coldd.dev/shop?cat=uniforms-gear): character clothing and equipment sets.
- [Animations & VFX](https://coldd.dev/shop?cat=animations-vfx): emote sets and particle effects.

Individual products live at `https://coldd.dev/product/<slug>` and carry
Product structured data (name, description, price in USD, availability,
breadcrumb, and an aggregate rating when the product has approved reviews).

## Company

- [About coldd](https://coldd.dev/about): who the team is and how the studio works.
- [Blog & Tutorials](https://coldd.dev/blog): development devlogs and Roblox/Luau how-to articles written by the team.
- [Releases](https://coldd.dev/releases): version history and changelogs for products.
- [Reviews](https://coldd.dev/reviews): verified buyer reviews.
- [FAQ](https://coldd.dev/faq): buying, licensing, downloads and support.
- [Contact](https://coldd.dev/contact): support form. Support email: support@coldd.dev. Community: https://discord.gg/coldd
